name: Ashby
summary: An all-in-one recruiting platform: applicant tracking, sourcing CRM, interview scheduling and analytics, with AI features across it. AI-Assisted Application Review evaluates each active application against criteria an admin writes per job and shows its reasoning criterion by criterion; Ashby Assistant and custom agents read and take a short list of actions inside the product under the user's own permissions. For outside clients the vendor runs a first-party MCP server in open beta at mcp.ashbyhq.com/mcp/v1, per-user OAuth, which answered 401 to a probe with no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: No credentials: MCP initialize answered 401 Bearer (scope openid mcp offline_access) on 2026-09-13, 09-17 and 09-26; POST api.ashbyhq.com/candidate.list answered 401 plain text on 09-13 and 09-26 (keyless GET on 09-17: 401). Per-user OAuth for MCP (DCR advertised, not exercised); API key for REST.

payments.notes: 2026-09-26: no surface read prices an agent call and no keyless request drew a 402; the authenticated side is unmeasured. Pricing FAQ: "Monthly plans require payment by credit card, while annual plans can be paid by credit card, direct deposit, and wire transfers." Terms: fees per Order, no refunds.

jobs.summary: AI-Assisted Application Review, the vendor's words: the AI "assesses candidate resumes against each specific criterion and returns an evaluation status" of meets, does not meet or undecided, and "Click on any criterion to see the reasoning". Skipped where a candidate opts out. Not measured.

The scheduling product, not the AI surface: the vendor says "Automation, templates, and self-serve options remove the need for back-and-forth", direct booking links let candidates book interviewer calendars, and the Advanced Auto-scheduling add-on generates schedules for panels and loops.
